coordinate_space: Each glyph ink bounds normalized to 0–100, y down
limitations: Pen motion is reconstructed, not recovered from the font designer.
Contextual alternates and ligatures are not prepared; base glyphs and pair kerning are preserved.
Unprepared Unicode appears whole using the selected font.
nib_units: physical font units; widths are diagnostic, temporal ownership is the active renderer
authorship: OpenEdit-authored semantic waypoints, refined onto medial ink; outline order never used

stroke_regions.method: Nearest physical trajectory + arc-length ownership; exact font contours remain final mask
